text: Each family has one card on file for the whole practice. Visits, refills, memberships and the online store all use it. Here's how to change it or remove it.
The Riveras' card on file is here, on the Financial tab.
Scout keeps when and where Maria said yes.
A card can be saved at a visit, in the online store, or when the family signs up for a membership. If they have no card yet, that card becomes the card on file.
Maria has a new card. Click Replace card.
Type the name and the new card. Nothing is charged.
Ask first. Read Maria what she's agreeing to.
When she says yes, tick the box.
Saved. The next visit, refill or store order uses the new card.
A membership keeps the card it's billed on. If Scout says a membership is billed on a different card, open the membership and use Update card.
If the family asks us to remove a card, click Remove card.
Remove takes it away everywhere: visits, the online store and the portal.
Type why the card is being removed.
Now there's no card on file.
If a membership or auto-ship is still billed on that card, the window names it first. The card is kept for that one only, so it keeps billing.
And if a card has expired, Scout shows it in red here and won't charge it. At checkout, take a new card with Tap to Pay or Type card manually, and ask to save it.
One card on file for the whole practice. Ask before you save one, and Remove takes it away everywhere.
